definitions.explanation: Thin noodles made from buckwheat flour, served either chilled with a dipping sauce or in hot broth. One of the most iconic Japanese noodle dishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{昼|ひる}→お昼：02532_ohiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蕎麦|そば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やっぱり→やっぱり：03005_yappari⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧{蕎麦|そば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Cold soba really is delicious in summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年越|としこ}し→年越し：12477_toshikoshi⟧{蕎麦|そば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧だ。
examples.english: It is a Japanese tradition to eat toshikoshi soba to ring in the new year.

notes:
Distinct from そば (beside, near). This word refers specifically to buckwheat noodles. The kanji {蕎麦|そば} is often written in hiragana on menus.

TYPES:
- ざる{蕎麦|そば} (chilled soba on a bamboo tray)
- かけ{蕎麦|そば} (soba in hot broth)
- ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧{蕎麦|そば} (soba with tempura)
- ⟦{年越|としこ}し→年越し：12477_toshikoshi⟧{蕎麦|そば} (New Year's Eve soba)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蕎麦|そば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧ (to boil soba)
- {蕎麦|そば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すする (to slurp soba)
- {蕎麦|そば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to make soba by hand)

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{年越|としこ}し→年越し：12477_toshikoshi⟧{蕎麦|そば} is eaten on New Year's Eve, symbolizing longevity and cutting off the hardships of the past year. {蕎麦|そば}{屋|や} (soba restaurants) are a staple of Japanese dining culture.
